scope: Read-only review of published reports, five numeric sample summaries, actual single-wrist extractor and local recorder, training reader, normalization, inference and deployed configuration files. No original HDF5 downloads, new local data collection, model loading, training, hardware or remote writes.
current_bottleneck: Task-level action supervision, timing/command semantics and a compatible trained single-wrist policy; calibration is no longer the principal blocker for beginning these tasks.

robomind.published_inspection: All numerical joint/gripper sequences from five selected episodes and first/middle/last images from both wrists; 30 decoded wrist images total, not all video frames.

samples.finding: Both arms move materially; cannot remove one based on task name.
Both arms move; gripper convention differs strongly from other samples; instruction unresolved.
Both arms move; file instruction says pen holder while directory says bucket.

door_preview.mapping_caveat: Project slot is logical; preserve physical right-side source identity. No automatic mirroring or sign change.
door_preview.numeric_units: source native; not yet certified local rad/metre targets
door_preview.violation_count_scope: Reported in pilot document; this review did not re-download the 2243-row raw source array.
door_preview.cannot_train_pick_place_from_this_alone: Only three images are retained, gripper does not perform grasp/release, time base is coarse, target semantics and platform mapping are unresolved.

needed_before_training: Source platform, ordered joint axes, signs and mechanical zero mapping to Piper H.
Leader/master to actually issued follower command definition; no same-frame state-to-action copy.
Per-batch gripper unit, sign, zero and total opening convention.
High-resolution time or documented nominal capture/alignment rules; equal integer seconds do not establish 20 Hz.
Single-arm task independence including any mobile base or other-arm support.
Complete selected episode wrist frames and episode/scene-separated training versus evaluation split.

nov22_short_static.interpretation: Short static observation and timestamp association works; dynamic timing and paired actual commands have not been demonstrated. Negative close reading is a zero-offset issue to verify at known openings, not a physical negative aperture.

old_h0_six_images.caveat: Historical transport configuration; do not apply old delay numbers to the new 90-frame session. SDK hook shows bytes handed to send layer, not bus delivery. Bench movement is not a successful task demonstration.

model_code.state: 6 measured joint radians + measured total gripper opening metres
model_code.action: 6 actual absolute joint target radians + absolute total opening metres
model_code.preprocessing: DeltaActions on first six axes relative to chunk-start measured q; gripper remains absolute; after prediction AbsoluteActions adds same start q once.
model_code.full_finetuning: nnx.Nothing freeze filter; gemma_2b and gemma_300m, internal action_dim=32
model_code.normalization: prepare-stats uses train episodes only and same action chunks; saves mean/std/q01/q99 under model-family-specific asset. pi0 uses continuous state and mean/std; pi05 discrete state and quantile.
model_code.inference: infer.py is read-only saved-observation inference, requires checkpoint/params plus that family/mount asset norm_stats.json. It does not send CAN or implement the live closed loop.
model_code.actual_configs: results/piper-real-single-v1/20261120_194402/pi0_full.json and pi05_full.json use wrist. Early task-module example files still use external_fixed; do not use them unchanged.
model_code.training_budget: Actual deployed configuration training fields remain null.
model_code.data_conversion_status: Aligned-episode reader exists; general raw record/public HDF5 to complete policy dataset converter is not yet implemented.

resource_scope.status: Separate environments/base weights/specs exist; no newly adapted real dataset, norms, training or inference results. Hardware capacity for two concurrent full jobs remains unverified.

recommended_next.local_lane: Use the existing unique sender to collect a complete local light-object pick/place pilot with real submitted targets and measured RGB/state, then validate the collection path before scaling local demonstrations. One pilot is not sufficient training data or success-rate evidence.
recommended_next.public_data_lane: Preserve the deeper 2026-11-23 review and new raw multi-view evidence. Left-arm pen placement and prepared-scene right-arm utensil segments are future candidates, not approved direct Piper H training data. No further public expansion is required before starting local demonstrations.
recommended_next.model_lane: Prepare separate pi0/pi05 experiment specs from actual wrist specs. Generate each norm only after qualified training episodes exist, then formally fine-tune; perform meaningful recorded-observation/online no-send evaluation with actual adapted checkpoints before model-driven real actions.
recommended_next.parallelism: Local collection-path work and independent model-configuration preparation can proceed together. The next dataset route is local demonstrations; public candidates are retained for later work. This does not prove that two full training jobs fit one 96 GB GPU.
recommended_next.dataset_decision: The bounded deeper public-data audit is complete. It found useful public raw material but no accepted training batch for this machine. Proceed with local task demonstrations as the engineering mainline; retain public subtask candidates for a later separate pilot.
recommended_next.experiment_labeling: Commissioning-only local data remain excluded from train/norm until explicitly selected for local adaptation. If local task demonstrations are used for training, report local adaptation rather than a public-only/zero-local-demonstration result.

primary_upstream_check.facts: Official pi0_base/pi05_base are listed for fine-tuning; README experts target DROID/ALOHA/LIBERO, with no matching Piper H single-wrist expert listed there. Full-finetuning reference requirement is >70 GB. This is not proof that no third-party Piper checkpoint exists.

superseded_by.scope: Recommendations and additional RoboMIND evidence; original five-episode and project-code factual observations remain valid.
superseded_by.latest_user_priority: Public RoboMIND first if suitable; otherwise collect local training demonstrations and provide detailed instructions. Zero-local-training is no longer a hard constraint.

publication_note: Compact review evidence. Local retrieval paths may refer to analysis-only source material that was not published; see README.md for the exact published subset. No complete source episode or training dataset is included.
